name: Casper Mountain County Park - Tower Hill Campground
note: Natrona County campground on the east end of Casper Mountain, off gravel Tower Hill Road below the communication towers: sites along a dirt road under pines and aspens, each with a fire ring and picnic table. The county publishes no site lengths, so confirm with the Parks Department that a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog (secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog, public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, tab 12056 'Casper Mountain', group 24945 'Tower Hill', read 2026-11-20): 'Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027. Reservation Only. Available 90 days in advance. Tower Hill campground is a beautifully wooded area surrounded by pine trees and aspens. Tower Hill has 8 sites. Each campsite has a fire ring and a picnic table. $13.39 a night plus taxes and fees'; 8 bookable items TH Site 01-08 at a 2026 'Nightly Rate' of $13.39. Rec1 group photos: a 'TOWER HILL CAMPGROUND <- / SLASH PILE / NC PARKS' sign and a graded gravel road through aspens; site photos (Oct-Nov 2022) show only the TH 1-8 site-number signs. Google Maps 'Tower Hill Campground' (42.7380474,-106.3104869, the county's own 'Directions' link; website = natronacounty-wy.gov/881/Tower-Hill-Campground), 4.3 on 4 reviews, no phone. campgroundviews.com: 'eight primitive campsites, each requiring a reservation', off East End Road on Tower Hill Road. County silent on rig length and no source shows pads under ~23 ft or tent-only/walk-in sites (AllStays' 'Tents' is its tents-allowed amenity tag, not tent-only) -> kept with an unclear-fit caveat (AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule); no agency road warning found (county pages 403, unread). Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World Imagery frames rendered at 42.73805,-106.31049 (~800 m, ~300 m and ~120 m half-widths), 42.7381,-106.3110 (~100 m) and 42.7379,-106.3080 (~160 m): a dirt campground road running east from a switchback of the gravel Tower Hill Road through dense pine/aspen forest, with open grassland and the hilltop communication towers to the south and cabins/meadow to the north; no lake, pond or stream visible anywhere in the 1.6 km frame. Rec1 describes only woods ('beautifully wooded area surrounded by pine trees and aspens'). -> not waterfront.
fees_source: Rec1 group 24945 'Tower Hill' ('$13.39 a night plus taxes and fees'); getLocationFacilities: all 8 sites 'Nightly Rate' base_fee 13.39, 2026-01-01..2026-12-31, read 2026-11-20.
sites_source: Rec1 group 24945 ('Tower Hill has 8 sites'; itemCount 8, items TH Site 01-08), read 2026-11-20.
hookups_source: Rec1 tab 12056 'Casper Mountain' ('Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.') + campgroundviews.com Tower Hill listing ('Please note that water and utility hookups are not available at this campground.'), read 2026-11-20.

facilities.note: One restroom, some sites a walk from it; no water at any Casper Mountain campground.

facilities_source: Rec1 tab 12056 ('Restroom facilities are provided at each Casper Mountain Campground. Water is not available at any of the Casper Mountain Campgrounds.') + campgroundviews.com ('A single restroom is available for campers; however, some campsites may be a distance from this facility.'), read 2026-11-20. Toilet type (vault/flush) not stated anywhere read.

season.note: Reopens May 28, 2027; the county does not publish a closing date.

season_source: Rec1 group 24945 ('Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027.'), read 2026-11-20.

booking.note: Reservation only, online (Rec1) or through the county Parks Department.

booking_source: Rec1 group 24945 ('Reservation Only. Available 90 days in advance.') + tab 12056 ('Casper Mountain Campgrounds are by reservation only'); Rec1 site photos (TH Site 01-08, EXIF Oct-Nov 2022) show each site's sign 'TH n / 10 DAY CAMPING LIMIT / ENJOY YOUR STAY / RESERVATIONS REQUIRED', read 2026-11-20.
flags: Rig fit unverified: the county publishes no site lengths; its campground map (natronacounty-wy.gov DocumentCenter/View/6375/TowerHill_041321, linked from the Rec1 group) was not fetched (site refuses). Rec1 photos show only site-number signs on trees and the graded gravel approach road; imagery shows a narrow dirt road under heavy canopy; no review read names a rig. Kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; the reviewer may prefer to hold it.

Pin is the county's own 'Directions to Tower Hill Campground' point (goo.gl -> Google place 42.7380474,-106.3104869), on the campground's dirt road ~110 m east of the Tower Hill Road switchback; sites are not visible under the canopy. campgroundviews.com gives 42.7380,-106.3071, ~280 m further east along the same road, where imagery shows a small clearing - the loop may extend that far.

Not a duplicate: ~0.48 km E of 15734 Elkhorn Springs, ~0.64 km N of 15733 Deer Haven and ~0.6 km NE of 6530 Beartrap, but on its own road (Tower Hill Road off East End Road) with its own sign and a separately named Rec1 facility with 8 sites (TH 01-08).

AllStays tags it 'All ages, Tents' (amenity tags, not tent-only); its detail pages served decoy data to the fetch helper (a 555 phone, unrelated site counts), so nothing was taken from them. iOverlander's page is login-gated; a search snippet of its review calls it quiet and 'nicely spaced with lots of privacy'.
visitcasper.com's 2024 warning about road construction on the mountain is dated; no current county road notice was readable.
Toilet type not sourced, so facilities carries only potable_water false.
